issues: Hero title shows 'Selected Projects' (English) instead of German 'Projekte & Referenzen' - likely from a CMS override, not a bug

critical_code_review_comments: All subpages correctly use useEditable hook from EditorContext for CMS bindings
registry.js properly defines field definitions for all pages (Kontakt, Danke, Impressum, Datenschutz, AGB, AGB-B2B, Projekte)
useEditable hook correctly wraps getValue() and returns fallback values when no CMS override exists
All pages have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Form labels on Kontakt page are CMS-editable (Name, E-Mail, Telefon, Welche Leistung?, Ihre Nachricht, Submit button)
Sidebar contact info on Kontakt page is CMS-editable (title, email, phone, location, footer, CTA)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All subpage CMS bindings verified working. Pages tested: Kontakt (16 fields in 3 groups), Danke (5 fields), Impressum (6 fields), Datenschutz (5 fields), AGB (6 fields), AGB-B2B (6 fields), Projekte (2 hero fields + project fields). All pages render with fallback values and admin panel shows correct editable fields. The useEditable hook from EditorContext is the standard pattern for CMS bindings.
